technical.summary: Uptrend structure intact with strong ADX and long-term MA alignment, but overbought RSI conditions, weak momentum confirmation (MACD 8/21 crossover down, OBV not rising), and lack of triggered strategies suggest caution on new entries at current levels.

fundamental.summary: PM shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 57 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts, dated trades (92-196 days old)
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and stale trades provide minimal confirmation; neutral overall sentiment with elevated downside risk.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 57 days adds moderate event risk; macro_score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX trending + EMA 50/200 bullish + Ichimoku above cloud + extreme fear (22/100) contrarian signal create structural uptrend with asymmetric risk/reward at support zone.
debate.key_bear_argument: VIX crisis regime (395.2), dual RSI overbought, MACD 8/21 crossover down, OBV not rising, no triggered strategies, weak fundamentals, and price below both 50/200 EMAs negate technical structure and signal momentum exhaustion into earnings risk.
debate.price_positioning: middle_of_range — weak entry; price equidistant from support (87.66) and resistance (90.64) with no clear directional conviction; overbought conditions and momentum divergence favor waiting for pullback to support or macro de-escalation.

decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment (395.2) combined with earnings event in 57 days and overbought momentum divergence creates elevated drawdown risk; price positioned mid-range with no clear directional conviction.
